rationale: Build directly on the winning two-block tail recurrence and the last run's QKV-focused endgame. Both recurrent tail decoder blocks are now hit twice before export, but the current best script only float-keeps QKV on the final block. This change makes the FP16 keep set recurrence-aware: preserve QKV for every active recurrent tail block while leaving training, quant-aware timing, and exact final evaluation untouched. The hypothesis is that penultimate-tail attention weights are now roundtrip-critical enough to justify the extra bytes, and the current 15.23MB artifact leaves enough headroom to spend that budget cleanly.
title: Extend FP16 QKV Rescue To Both Recurrent Tail Blocks
